summary: In March 2022, one person was accused of the sexual assault of a child in Chatra, Jharkhand. The charges also include attempted murder, wrongful confinement, wrongful restraint, causing hurt with a weapon and causing hurt. A weapon was used or a threat was made. Police have filed a chargesheet. The accused was convicted and sentenced to 4 years in prison. An appeal against the verdict has been filed. Identifying details are withheld by law (POCSO s.23).
title: Sexual assault of a child — Chatra (2022) — convicted, 4 years
